subject: Oceanography
title: Transform Boundaries
description: A fast breakdown of Transform Boundaries for builders.

hook.text: Not all plate boundaries pull apart or collide—some slide sideways past each other.

buildup.text: Transform faults cut across mid-ocean ridges, offsetting them into stair-step patterns.

discovery.text: These faults accommodate different spreading rates along the ridge—the crust can't stretch evenly.

twist.text: The San Andreas Fault is a transform boundary on land—two plates grinding past each other.

climax.text: Transform faults produce shallow but powerful earthquakes along the ocean floor.

punchline.text: Some plates don't push or pull—they grind sideways.

quiz.question: What is a transform boundary?
options: Where plates slide horizontally past each other
